translation_notes: prefixes: RDF->rdf, PROV->prov, XSD->xsd (RDF and XSD are unused both before and after translation; they come from the file-level import block the extractor kept, not from this region).

The region's single extracted operation (rdf_ops: 1, categories.namespace_term: 1) is one line: `PROV.wasAttributedTo not in self.graph.predicates(container_entity, script_agent)`, a trav_existence read via `Graph.predicates(s, o)` (filters by BOTH subject and object) rather than the more usual `(s, p, o) in g`. Direct translation: `not bool(m{ {container_entity} prov:wasAttributedTo {script_agent} })`. The other ~85 lines of the region (the `else` branch: `_add_Function`, `_add_FunctionExecution`, per-input/output entity loops, `wasDerivedFrom` products, `wasAssociatedWith`) touch no namespace term and are untranslated Python, unchanged -- there is nothing in that branch for this stratum to credit or debit, and INSTRUCTIONS.md SS2 forbids restructuring, so it stays exactly as extracted, including its own now-unresolved names (`Container`, `_get_function_name`, `ONTOLOGY_INFORMATION`) -- dead code in every fixture this driver runs, since `demo()` only exercises the `_is_membership` branch.

context_shim.py: minimal `AlpacaProvDocument` stand-in (self.graph, a recorded-not-executed `_wasAttributedTo`, identity `_create_entity`, no-op `_add_membership`) plus faithful namedtuple reproductions of `FunctionInfo`/`FunctionExecution` from alpaca/alpaca_types.py:29-44, and `membership_execution()` reproducing the exact `input={0: ...}, params={'index': ...}, output={0: ...}` shape that `Provenance._add_container_relationships` builds at alpaca/decorator.py:522-538 for subscript/attribute accesses -- confirmed by reading both files at the pinned commit via `gh api`. The `alpaca` package itself is NOT installed: it is not the same project as the unrelated 10 KB package named `alpaca` on PyPI (checked with `pip download alpaca==1.0.0 --no-deps`, a 10 KB unrelated tarball) and the real INM-6/alpaca has no matching PyPI distribution, so it is `classification: excluded`-worthy on its own, but is sidestepped entirely here by the shim (same pattern as the sibling `IndustryFusion.../Entity_add_contentclass_if_missing` region), so no dependency actually blocks this region.

demo() harness (identical on both sides, see meta.json): builds a fresh AlpacaProvDocument(graph) from caller-supplied Turtle, runs the region on a subscript-kind execution, returns the count of `_wasAttributedTo` calls -- the one bit of information the read decides. Four calls: (1) exact triple present -> not called; (2) absent entirely -> called; (3) same subject/predicate but a DIFFERENT object (agent) -> called, proving the object is part of the match; (4) same predicate/object but a DIFFERENT subject (container) -> called, proving the subject is part of the match too. `self.graph.predicates(s, o)` filters by both, so cases 3-4 are the neighbourhood a looser translation (e.g. dropping the object and matching on predicate+subject only) would silently pass without.

Deliberately broke the translation (replaced `{script_agent}` with an unbound `?anyagent` in the m{ } pattern, dropping the object from the match) to confirm rdfeval check catches it: FAIL call[2].result: values differ (1 vs 0) -- case 3 (attributed to a DIFFERENT agent) should still call _wasAttributedTo (1) but the loosened pattern matched on predicate+subject alone and wrongly returned 0. Restored, check is green again.

repair.driver: three calls added (7 in all): (5) container and agent linked by another predicate only (prov:wasAssociatedWith) -> called; (6) linked by that predicate AND by prov:wasAttributedTo -> not called; (7) an attributed container in the neighbourhood the repository writes around it (rdf:type alpaca:DataObjectEntity, prov:hadMember, prov:wasGeneratedBy, the activity prov:wasAssociatedWith the agent, the child attributed to another agent) -> not called. Docstring lists what each call exercises.

optimization_notes: optimized.py: `PROV.wasAttributedTo not in self.graph.predicates(c, a)` becomes `(c, PROV.wasAttributedTo, a) not in self.graph`; the nested `_is_membership` helper is inlined into the `if`; `child_entity` and `info_id` are inlined; the input loop builds `cur_entities` with a comprehension over `value.elements if isinstance(value, Container) else [value]`; the `bool()` around `get_uri` goes (only its truth is tested); backslash continuations are joined. Every call keeps its order of evaluation.
The else branch is dead in the driver (it uses names the extraction does not resolve): its compression is checked by reading only.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: `not m{ {container_entity} prov:wasAttributedTo {script_agent} }(self.graph)`, with a call suffix instead of the translation's `@graph self.graph` (one island only).
No other exception to the symmetry rule: outside the RDF lines the two files are identical line for line.
